# gravity_role_tsdb (Resource)

Configuration of the TSDB role, which records metrics about the cluster.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "gravity_role_tsdb" "tsdb" {
  enabled = true
  # Keep metrics for 30 minutes, collecting every 30 seconds
  expire = 1800
  scrape = 30
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Defaults to `true`.
- `expire` (Number) How long recorded metrics are kept, in seconds. Defaults to `1800`.
- `scrape` (Number) Interval between metric collections, in seconds. Defaults to `30`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Role configurations are singletons, identified by the role name
terraform import gravity_role_tsdb.tsdb 'tsdb'
```
